proposals.title: Downward Bottle Neck Grasp
proposals.note: The prescribed 80%-height neck target, 0.12 m standoff, and retained downward quaternion reached and carried the bottle on seeds 51-55; the complete literal policy passed 5/5. The side-wrist comparison was not retested.

proposals.title: Segmented Fixture Top Placement
proposals.note: The cabinet top slice held 5613-6534 points, and the three lift/translate/lower moves completed on every seed. Release was 0.1270-0.1286 m above the estimated cabinet surface; final keyframes place the bottle over the cabinet top and task success was 5/5. No isolated placement ablation was run.

proposals.title: grasp.md Cylindrical Side Grasp: downward-neck alternative
proposals.note: The downward alternative composed with the existing grasp template and carried the bottle through 5/5 placements; this verification did not run a side-grasp counterfactual.

notes: The first attempt alone passed all five independent seeded episodes in 345-354 control steps; no second attempt was needed. The first move_to_pose was tried once and succeeded on all five, so retry guidance was not exercised. Reading rules were respected.
